mechanism: Deutetrabenazine is a CYP3A4 substrate and ranolazine is a CYP3A4 inhibitor, potentially increasing deutetrabenazine exposure; additive QT prolongation risk exists with both agents.
action: Monitor QTc interval and deutetrabenazine efficacy/tolerability; consider ECG baseline and periodic monitoring; dose adjustment of deutetrabenazine may be necessary.
